{{- /* creator/sort-pages.html — (dict "nodes" "by" "cards|date|menu") cards: weight asc (weighted first) → date desc (arch/26 §1.7) date : date desc menu : weight asc → lower title → slug (jasper rule) Stable sort passes, least significant key first. */ -}} {{- $l := .nodes -}} {{- $by := .by | default "cards" -}} {{- if eq $by "menu" -}} {{- $l = sort $l "slug" -}} {{- $l = sort $l "t" -}} {{- $l = sort $l "w" -}} {{- $l = sort $l "wg" -}} {{- else if eq $by "date" -}} {{- $l = sort $l "date" "desc" -}} {{- else -}} {{- $l = sort $l "date" "desc" -}} {{- $l = sort $l "w" -}} {{- $l = sort $l "wg" -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Foundry stringifies non-string returns → JSON; callers pipe to transform.Unmarshal. */ -}} {{- $out := "[]" -}} {{- with $l -}}{{- $out = . | jsonify -}}{{- end -}} {{- return $out -}}
